# Uptime.is

> > SLA and uptime calculator for determining downtime allowances across different availability targets and service level agreements.

Uptime.is provides tools for calculating, comparing, and analyzing service level agreement (SLA) metrics, including downtime calculations for various uptime percentages (99%, 99.5%, 99.9%, etc.) with support for custom schedules and weekday monitoring. Built with newLISP.

## Key Topics

- SLA (Service Level Agreement)
- Uptime calculation
- Downtime calculation
- Availability metrics
- 99.9% uptime (three nines)
- 99.5% uptime
- Nines uptime targets
- Availability monitoring
- Custom schedule monitoring
- Weekday monitoring
- SLA comparison
- Downtime analysis
- Uptime reporting
- newLISP

## SLA Calculators

- [SLA & Uptime calculator: How much downtime corresponds to 99.9 % uptime](https://uptime.is/): Homepage SLA calculator for 99.9% uptime and downtime metrics
- [SLA & Uptime calculator: How much downtime corresponds to 99.5 % uptime](https://uptime.is/99.5): SLA calculator showing downtime for 99.5% uptime availability target
- [SLA & Uptime calculator: How much downtime corresponds to 99 % uptime](https://uptime.is/complex?sla=99&wk=pqryhyu): Complex SLA calculator with custom weekday schedule for 99% uptime

## Comparison Tools

- [Compare SLA Uptime & Downtime](https://uptime.is/compare?sla=97): SLA comparison tool for analyzing uptime and downtime across targets
